method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; two regulative rules (s 10 apply for review within 28 days; s 22B (2) reasons statement within 28 days) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: ACT Civil and Administrative Tribunal Act 2008 (ACT), A2008-35, Republication No 42 (R42), effective 23 February 2026, last amended by A2026-4, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A2008-35.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is (c) Australian Capital Territory, used under CC BY 4.0; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the individual bringing or answering an application to the ACT Civil and Administrative Tribunal: the person with a civil dispute up to $25 000 (debt, contract, goods or services, negligence damages, nuisance, trespass) or seeking review of a government decision under an authorising law (acat-claims.l4)
focus: the provisions a claimant meets: jurisdiction and the $25 000 limit, the review time limit, reasons statements, costs, absence and non-compliance, orders and reasons, enforcement, appeals

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run acat-dates.l4 ; l4 run acat-claims.l4 ; l4 run acat-cases.l4
checks.result: 144 assertions written, 144 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: Part 3 whole (ss 9-12); Part 4 whole (ss 15-22); ss 22B, 22D, 22T; s 25 (2), (3); ss 47A, 48, 48A, 49, 53, 54 (2), 56 (c) (i); ss 59, 60; ss 67A, 67B; ss 69A, 71, 74; ss 79, 80 (1), 82A, 83, 86 (with s 85). Out: Parts 1-2, the rest of Part 4A (certificates, non-disclosure), the rest of Parts 5-6 (procedure, hearings, witnesses, member interests, occupational discipline, review outcomes), ss 72-73, 75-78, 80 (2)-(3), 81-82, 84, 87, Parts 9, 9A, 10: machinery or not a claimant's provision. Reasons in NOTES.md.
